markdown_content: ## Overview of AI Pose Generator in Clo 2025.0 This section introduces the AI Pose Generator feature released in Clo 2025.0, explaining its location in the software and basic operational context. The AI Pose Generator automatically creates avatar poses based on images or text prompts, enhancing workflow efficiency for fashion design and styling within Clo. --- ## Locating and Accessing the AI Pose Generator Feature The AI Pose Generator is accessible from the top toolbar in Clo under **Avatar > AI Pose Generator (Beta)**. Upon activation, a warning appears indicating that all avatars and garments currently in the 3D window will be deleted. To avoid losing work, it is recommended to start a new blank file before opening the AI Pose Generator. - **Important:** Opening the AI Pose Generator clears the 3D window, removing all existing avatars and garments. - The feature is currently in **beta**, meaning it is still being refined based on user feedback. --- ## Using the AI Pose Generator Interface The AI Pose Generator window enables users to create poses via two main methods: 1. **Text Prompt Generation:** - Select avatar gender (male or female). Poses generated can be applied to either gender. - Enter descriptive text prompts (e.g., "jumping up") to generate image-based poses. - Use the **Generate** button to produce pose images based on the prompt. - Multiple images can be generated for selection. - Users can adjust the avatar’s position using the **Show Avatar Joints** tool (shortcut: Shift + X) to move parts like feet off the ground or adjust limbs. - Save preferred poses to the pose library. 2. **Keyword Suggestions:** - Keywords are grouped into categories such as **Basic Poses** (running, standing, walking) and **Action & Sports Poses** (archer jumping, basketball, soccer shooting). - Up to two keywords per category can be selected simultaneously. - Keywords combine with text prompts to refine pose generation. - Clicking a selected keyword deselects it. - The **Pin** option allows generating similar poses based on the current prompt, useful for fine-tuning. 3. **Random Prompt Generator:** - By clicking the dice icon, the system generates a random pose prompt. - Users can then add keywords or modify the prompt to customize results. --- ## Managing Generated Poses and History - All generated images are saved in a **History** panel within the AI Pose Generator window. - Users can revisit previous images, regenerate poses, select multiple poses, and save them collectively to their computer. - Saved poses become part of the user's pose library in Clo and can also be stored externally on the desktop or other folders for sharing or backup. --- ## Uploading Custom Images for Pose Generation - Users can upload their own full-body images to generate poses. - For best results: - Use full-body images with no obstructions or hidden limbs. - Ensure a clear background contrasts with the subject. - Prefer real human photos over animated or illustrated characters. - After uploading, clicking **Generate** creates a pose from the image. - Uploaded poses can be adjusted using avatar joints (Shift + X) and saved similarly to AI-generated poses. --- ## Workflow Recommendations and Best Practices - To avoid losing work, create garments and save them before opening the AI Pose Generator in a new file. - Build a personalized pose library by generating and saving multiple poses for different styling scenarios (e.g., fitting poses, stylized poses). - Use the pose library to quickly apply poses in future projects, enabling a plug-and-play style workflow. - Adjust garments after applying poses to correct any skewing or distortion caused by pose changes. - The AI Pose Generator beta is a powerful tool but may require manual tweaks for perfect results. --- ## Summary The AI Pose Generator in Clo 2025.0 is a sophisticated feature that leverages text prompts, keyword suggestions, and image uploads to automatically create realistic avatar poses. It streamlines the fashion design workflow by allowing users to generate, customize, and save poses efficiently. Understanding the interface, managing pose history, and following workflow best practices ensures optimal use of this evolving beta feature.
